scorecard.rationale: The two original Alzheimer trial arms each reported one combined fall-or-dizziness event. Three additional dementia cases used turmeric powder in capsules and measured behavioral symptoms and caregiver distress without separate falls. Parkinson formulated-curcumin studies give composite motor or safety outcomes. A stopped multi-supplement arm supplies no attributable comparison. Different Huntington model diets produced opposing rotarod results and a heterogeneous Parkinson rodent synthesis favored longer rotarod performance. No family isolates culinary ground turmeric and Parkinson fall frequency, so the scorecard remains open.
